source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 3. Exercises reused from the lesson.

learn.en: Allah is All-Knowing. He knows what is in the heavens, our secrets, and even what is in our hearts.
learn.title: All-Knowing

learn.en: He knows where every leaf will fall, every grain of sand, the weight of every mountain and what is deep in the oceans.
learn.title: Every leaf

learn.en: He knows the breaths we breathe and the words we speak, in the day and at night.
learn.title: Nothing is hidden

learn.en: Allah is All-Seeing. He sees everything we do and is aware of everything.
learn.title: All-Seeing

learn.en: “And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.” (Qur'an 2:265)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: Allah knows what is in our ___.
Allah sees what we do in the ___.
True or false? Allah knows where every leaf will fall.
True or false? We can hide a secret from Allah.

think.q: If nobody is watching, but Allah sees you, how should you behave?
think.a: The same as when everyone is watching — honest and kind, because Allah sees.

parents.summary: Allah is al-ʿAlīm (All-Knowing) and al-Baṣīr (All-Seeing): nothing in the universe or in our hearts is hidden from Him.
parents.tip: Use “Allah sees me” as a gentle reminder, never as a threat.
